content: The new Smart Shuffle feature is awful — it keeps playing the same 4 songs on repeat instead of discovering new tracks.
Offline downloads keep corrupting when I switch between Wi-Fi and 5G. I lost 400 downloaded tracks before my flight.
The lyrics sync feature is fantastic! Real-time scrolling with zero delay makes karaoke so much fun.
Why can't I search within collaborative playlists anymore on Android? Huge regression in the latest update.
Customer wants Enterprise team audio subscription for 500 employee co-working spaces with centralized billing.
The desktop app is using 2.5 GB of RAM when playing lossless audio in the background. Please fix memory leak.
Podcast recommendations are completely irrelevant — I listen to tech news but my homepage is filled with celebrity gossip.
Family Plan admin controls should allow setting explicit content filters per individual kid account.
CarPlay interface is super clean and responsive. Big touch buttons make driving and switching playlists safe.
Annual subscription receipt does not show tax breakdown required for business expense reimbursement.
The equalizer presets make my Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones sound incredible. Best audio processing update yet!
DJ AI voice speaks too frequently between songs and interrupts the party vibe. Need a toggle to reduce chatter.
Unable to update billing credit card — form gets stuck on 3DS verification spinning wheel on mobile web.
Canvas video loops on lockscreen drain battery much faster than standard album art. Please add low-power mode toggle.
Hi-Res Lossless FLAC tier — when is it finally launching? Apple Music and Tidal already have it for the same price.
